semantics: The routine initializes the VDP destination command to 0x70000003, then for 224 iterations adds the next A1 source word into D0, advances the source offset by two bytes, masks the accumulator to 9 bits, and writes the word twice to the VDP data port.
conclusion: The former 0x001B1DDA-0x001B1E09 UNKNOWN range is a complete accumulated VDP word-stream writer. Its caller and presentation asset remain unresolved.
